subject: Re: Sherpa Analytics renewal — flexible commit & pricing path
messages:
From: Amanda Liu <amanda.liu@sherpa-analytics.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: carlos.m@sherpa-analytics.com
Date: Fri, 24 Apr 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal discussion — usage growth + pricing levers

Markus — thanks again for the chat this morning. As discussed, Sherpa expects an approximate 2.5x growth in inference consumption next year driven by a new vector search product line. We need a path that keeps our unit economics predictable while allowing us to add burst capacity quickly.

High-level asks: 
- A 12–18 month renewal with a modest step-up commit (from 10k to 18k GPU-hours/month)
- A temporary price hold for 90 days post-launch while we stabilize usage
- A pool of credits for overage protection in Q1 after launch

We attached a simple forecast and would appreciate three concrete options: conservative (lower commit, higher overage), growth-aligned (step-up commit + credits), and aggressive (larger commit + deeper discount). Can you share a draft term sheet this week?

—Amanda
Head of Platform, Sherpa Analytics

Attachments: Sherpa_forecast_Q2-Q4.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: Amanda Liu <amanda.liu@sherpa-analytics.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 24 Apr 2027 12:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion — usage growth + pricing levers

Amanda — thanks for the clarity and the forecast. Looping in Marissa (Renewals) and Ben (Account Exec) so we can pull together options. Quick thoughts based on what you outlined: 

1) Growth-aligned option (recommended): 18k committed GPU-hrs/month, 6% blended unit discount, 3-month price hold for baseline tiers, and a 200k-token credit bucket usable for burst/overage.
2) Conservative: keep commit at 12k, smaller (3%) discount, higher overage rates.
3) Aggressive: 24k commit with 9% discount and a 6-month staged price hold while adoption reaches steady-state.

We can map those to a phased canary launch (you can enable burst pool for 30% extra capacity). I will upload a worksheet with the modeled run rate and ARR impact within the hour.

—Markus
VP Sales, Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Amanda Liu <amanda.liu@sherpa-analytics.com>
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 24 Apr 2027 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Sherpa renewal — detailed options attached

Amanda — attaching our modeled term sheet and pricing summary (Sherpa_Renewal_Options_v2.xlsx and redwood-pricing-summary.pdf). Short summary below: 

Option A — Growth-aligned (recommended):
- Commit: 18k GPU-hrs/mo
- Discount: 6% off published hosted rates
- Price hold: 90 days for baseline tiers (no changes to reserved pricing)
- Overage protection: 200k token credit applied to first 60 days of overage, then blended overage rates
- Support: Standard success plan + 8 hours/month onboarding sessions for first 2 months

Option B — Conservative:
- Commit: 12k GPU-hrs/mo
- Discount: 3%
- No price hold, smaller credit bucket (75k tokens)

Option C — Aggressive:
- Commit: 24k GPU-hrs/mo
- Discount: 9%
- Price hold: 6 months with staged reprice after month 4
- Overage: 350k token credit

Next steps I propose: you and Carlos pick the top choice, we confirm minimum term (12 vs 18 months), and Ben will prepare a final SOW/DocuSign. If you want, we can schedule a 30-minute call early next week to walk the numbers.

—Marissa
Director, Customer Renewals

Attachments: Sherpa_Renewal_Options_v2.xlsx; redwood-pricing-summary.pdf

From: Amanda Liu <amanda.liu@sherpa-analytics.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: carlos.m@sherpa-analytics.com, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 27 Apr 2027 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sherpa renewal — detailed options attached

Marissa / Markus — thanks for the clear options and the modeled sheet. We discussed internally and here are our preferences and constraints: 

- Preference: Option A (Growth-aligned) but we need the price hold extended to 120 days to cover the launch ramp risk.
- Minimum term: 12 months to start, with a reassessment window at month 9 tied to actual consumption.
- Credit structure: can we make the 200k token credit usable only for overage on inference requests tied to the new VectorSearch product (to avoid gaming)?

Also two asks from procurement: 1) a clause allowing a one-time 30-day extension of the price hold if launch is delayed for reasons outside of Sherpa's control, and 2) a short audit clause outlining required logs for Q3-Q4. Procurement asked to see a redline before Thursday. Can Ben share the SOW draft and a redline-friendly Word/PDF?

—Amanda

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Amanda Liu <amanda.liu@sherpa-analytics.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sherpa renewal — pricing redline & next steps

Amanda — appreciate the specificity. Deliverables on our end this week: 
1) Draft SOW + redline-friendly Word version (DocuSign-ready) — attaching a first pass to this thread (see Sherpa_Renewal_Options_v2.xlsx and the DocuSign link in Related Links).
2) We will update Option A to include a 120-day price hold, a one-time 30-day extension clause, and a scoped audit log appendix for Q3-Q4.
3) We will gate the 200k credit to requests tagged for the VectorSearch product and will include logging and enforcement language in the SOW.

Can we schedule a Thursday 30-minute review at 10:00am PT to iterate on redlines? If that works, I will send a calendar invite and the Word redline.

Thanks — looking forward to wrapping this up.

—Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs referenced: Sherpa_Renewal_Options_v2.xlsx (Excel), redwood-pricing-summary.pdf (PDF)
